name: HIPAA Security Rule
description: The HIPAA Security Rule establishes national standards to protect individuals' electronic personal health information (ePHI) that is created, received, used, or maintained by a covered entity or business associate.
organization: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

pending_amendments.summary: HHS NPRM published January 6, 2025 proposes significant HIPAA Security Rule updates. Key proposed changes: (1) Eliminate required/addressable distinction — all specifications become mandatory; (2) Mandatory encryption for all ePHI at rest and in transit; (3) Multi-factor authentication (MFA) required for all workforce access to ePHI systems; (4) Annual penetration testing required; (5) Biannual vulnerability scanning required; (6) 72-hour breach notification to HHS (down from 60 days for most breaches); (7) Written incident response plan testing annually; (8) Technology asset inventory and network map required and reviewed annually; (9) Business associate agreement updates required within 180 days of final rule.
pending_amendments.action_required: Monitor for final rule publication (targeted May 2026). Begin gap assessment against proposed requirements, particularly for encryption and MFA which may require significant technical remediation.

categories.name: Administrative Safeguards
categories.description: Administrative actions, policies, and procedures to manage the selection, development, implementation, and maintenance of security measures.

controls.name: Security Management Process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.

requirements.description: Risk Analysis — Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of ePHI.
requirements.guidance: Document all ePHI assets, threats, vulnerabilities, and current controls. Calculate likelihood and impact for each risk.

requirements.description: Risk Management — Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.
requirements.guidance: Prioritize and remediate identified risks. Document risk acceptance decisions.

requirements.description: Sanction Policy — Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with security policies.
requirements.guidance: Include clear escalation steps from warning to termination in the sanction policy.

requirements.description: Information System Activity Review — Regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.
requirements.guidance: Review logs at least weekly. Automate alerting for anomalous activity.

controls.name: Workforce Security
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of the workforce have appropriate access to ePHI and to prevent those who do not have access from obtaining access.

requirements.description: Authorization and/or Supervision — Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with ePHI.
requirements.guidance: Document role-based access controls and supervisory responsibilities.

requirements.description: Workforce Clearance Procedure — Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to ePHI is appropriate.
requirements.guidance: Perform background checks and verify credentials before granting ePHI access.

requirements.description: Termination Procedures — Implement procedures for terminating access to ePHI when the employment of a workforce member ends.
requirements.guidance: Disable accounts and retrieve devices within 24 hours of termination.

controls.name: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce.

requirements.description: Security Reminders — Periodic security updates to workforce members.
requirements.guidance: Send security awareness communications at least quarterly.

requirements.description: Protection from Malicious Software — Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
requirements.guidance: Train workforce on phishing recognition and safe computing practices annually.

controls.name: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.

requirements.description: Response and Reporting — Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate harmful effects; and document incidents and their outcomes.
requirements.guidance: Maintain an incident response plan and test it at least annually.

controls.name: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Establish policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems containing ePHI.

requirements.description: Data Backup Plan — Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of ePHI.
requirements.guidance: Perform daily backups and test restores at least quarterly.

requirements.description: Disaster Recovery Plan — Establish and implement procedures to restore any loss of data.
requirements.guidance: Document RTO and RPO objectives and test the plan annually.

categories.name: Physical Safeguards
categories.description: Physical measures, policies, and procedures to protect electronic information systems and related buildings and equipment from natural and environmental hazards and unauthorized intrusion.

controls.name: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to electronic information systems and the facilities in which they are housed.

requirements.description: Contingency Operations — Establish procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan.
requirements.guidance: Document emergency access procedures and test them annually.

requirements.description: Facility Security Plan — Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and equipment from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.
requirements.guidance: Use badge access, security cameras, and visitor logs for all areas housing ePHI systems.

controls.name: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain ePHI.

requirements.description: Disposal — Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of ePHI and the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.
requirements.guidance: Use NIST 800-88 media sanitization guidelines. Document all disposal actions.

requirements.description: Media Re-use — Implement procedures for removal of ePHI from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.
requirements.guidance: Perform cryptographic erasure or physical destruction before media reuse.

categories.name: Technical Safeguards
categories.description: Technology, policies, and procedures for its use that protect ePHI and control access to it.

controls.name: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI to allow access only to authorized persons or software programs.

requirements.description: Unique User Identification — Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.
requirements.guidance: Prohibit shared accounts. Each user must have a unique identifier.

requirements.description: Automatic Logoff — Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.
requirements.guidance: Configure session timeout of 15 minutes or less for ePHI access.

requirements.description: Encryption and Decryption — Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.
requirements.guidance: Encrypt ePHI at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2+.

controls.name: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use ePHI.

requirements.description: Implement and monitor audit logging for all systems that create, receive, maintain, or transmit ePHI.
requirements.guidance: Log all access to ePHI records. Retain logs for at least 6 years.

controls.name: Integrity
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

requirements.description: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that ePHI has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.
requirements.guidance: Use checksums, digital signatures, or hash verification for ePHI integrity.

controls.name: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

requirements.description: Integrity Controls — Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted ePHI is not improperly modified without detection.
requirements.guidance: Use message authentication codes (MACs) or digital signatures.

requirements.description: Encryption — Implement a mechanism to encrypt ePHI whenever deemed appropriate.
requirements.guidance: Encrypt all ePHI transmitted over public networks using TLS 1.2+.
